brief: Read SPEC.md and design the rate limiter it asks for. Write DESIGN.json in the repository root with exactly these keys: "algorithm" (one of "token_bucket", "fixed_window", "sliding_log", "sliding_window_counter"), "store" (one of "process_memory", "redis", "postgres"), "key" (one of "ip", "api_key", "user_id"), "rate_per_second" (a number), "burst" (a number) and "reasons" (a list of short strings).
